sponsored.t: Authorizes an optional 20-year retirement benefits plan for Elmira traffic officers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an optional 20-year retirement plan for traffic officers employed by the town of Elmira, who submit an application therefor within one year of the effective date of such provisions, or within one year of start of employment.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the renewal of the WSKG lease for such land, tower and associated utility lines
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the renewal of the WSKG lease for such land, tower and associated utility lines to the Tioga county emergency services, the Newark Valley central school district, the Berkshire fire department and the town of Berkshire highway department for a period of ten years.

sponsored.t: Relates to acts of the Legislature having fiscal impacts on local governments
sponsored.sum: Requires the legislature to provide funding to reimburse localities for the costs associated with expenditures made as a requirement of any law which mandates the undertaking of a new program or increases the level of service of an existing program by a locality; requires the legislature to establish procedures for the allocation of funds among the local governments.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain uses of premises for which no duty is owed to keep premises safe
sponsored.sum: Provides that the owner, lessee or occupant of premises owes no duty to keep the premises safe for entry or use by others engaged generally in recreational activities.

sponsored.t: Provides that state departments, offices, agencies, and authorities are prohibited from imposing any fees, surcharges, or taxes that have not been approved
sponsored.sum: Provides that state departments, offices, agencies, and authorities are prohibited from imposing any fees, surcharges, or taxes that have not been approved by the state legislature.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to pass enabling legislation before entering into any compact, program or other legal agreement with any other state
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to pass enabling legislation before entering into any compact, program or other legal agreement with any other state.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Chemung to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Chemung to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes to November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Tioga to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Tioga to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2027.
